title: Subscription
subtitle: Import your subscription link and tailor the routing rules.

link.title: Subscription link
link.subtitle: Add this link to your client to get every node. Keep it private.
link.savedHint: The link uses the routing rules you save below.
link.overrideHint: The link carries a template parameter; your saved rules stay unchanged.
link.qrHint: Scan with a mobile client to import the subscription.

import.title: One-click import
import.copyOnly: {clients} and others: copy the link and add it in the client.

reset.title: Reset your subscription link?
reset.description: A new URL and UUID are generated. The old link stops working immediately, so every device has to import the new one.
reset.done: Subscription reset. Import the new link in your clients.

preview.title: Config preview
preview.hint: See the config generated for each client from your saved rules.
preview.hintOverride: The preview uses the template selected for the link.

builder.title: Routing rules
builder.subtitle: Start from a template, then adjust categories and policy groups. Saved rules apply to your link automatically.
builder.readOnly: The administrator turned off custom routing rules; everyone uses the default template.
builder.templatesHint: A template sets the default categories and policy groups.
builder.sourceHint: Preferred open-source rule sets; categories it lacks come from the next source.
builder.categoriesHint: Turn on the services to route and pick the policy for each.
builder.groupsHint: Groups shown in the client, in order. Proxy is the required main group.
builder.proxyHint: Main group; it can't be renamed or removed.
builder.includeHint: Comma separated: other group names, DIRECT, REJECT, * for all nodes, or a regex on node names (e.g. Hong Kong|HK).
builder.geoipHint: Added before the final rule; recommended inside China.
builder.switchTemplateHint: Switching replaces your changes to categories, groups and the final policy (source, mirror and DNS are kept).
builder.resetHint: Categories, policy groups and the final policy go back to the template defaults.

groupName.reserved: DIRECT and REJECT are reserved names
groupName.duplicate: A group with this name already exists
groupName.proxy: The Proxy group can't be renamed

info.title: Subscription details
info.hint: The UUID authenticates you on the nodes. Resetting changes both the link and the UUID; the old link stops working immediately.
